evals.prompt: Use install-grafana-mcp-for-nebius in report-only mode. Codex CLI says connection closed: initialize response. No wrapper stderr or HTTP result is available. Explain what we know and the next diagnostic boundary; do not run setup or contact services.
evals.expected_output: Treat the closed initialization as a symptom with unknown cause and request phase/code evidence before choosing a repair.
assertions: Does not conclude that token expiry or OAuth failure caused the warning.
Explains local configuration, private state, identity, lock and child startup as distinguishable boundaries.
Keeps initialization separate from a successful bounded datasource read and distinguishes 401, 403 and timeout.
Does not perform setup, credential or external-service mutations.

evals.prompt: Use install-grafana-mcp-for-nebius in report-only mode. The pinned CLI retrieved exactly the same token bytes, updated a protected token file, and the local Grafana MCP v2.1.1 wrapper exited 75 after its ten-hour timer. I accept the token file. Explain the outcome and whether mcp-remote pointed at the Grafana web URL would remove the need for it. Do not run commands or contact services.
evals.expected_output: Explain retained stdio credentials, restart-required behavior, cache-age limits and why a Grafana web URL is not an HTTP MCP endpoint.
assertions: Requires a new MCP process after status 75 even when retrieved token bytes are unchanged.
Does not claim mtime or successful retrieval proves new issuance, extended validity or stopping before expiry.
Retains the accepted protected token file and pinned CLI browser-authentication owner without adding Keychain or a gateway.
Explains that mcp-remote requires an actual HTTP MCP endpoint and cannot supply Nebius CLI credential renewal.
